posts.title: The Oboe Knight
posts.description: A courtly knight descends into a derelict corporate sub-basement, chasing the oboe melody that has comforted him since childhood. He discovers the song is a looping hold-queue lure, and every brave note he hums feeds an ancient machine starving to extend its signal to the world above.

posts.title: Dreamreel
posts.description: A one-armed dream-mancer hires a blunt-spoken mercenary to breach a sealed tower whose leaking gas forces a village to relive the deaths of long-dead sorcerers.

posts.title: Mr. Sixpounder
posts.description: In a demon-haunted hotel where ancient pacts govern the behavior of monstrous long-term residents, a meticulous concierge must manage a single catastrophic night: an off-schedule revenant, a lobby of insurance demons, and a vanished pact book.
